title: Chainalysis Discloses Data Breach Involving Agentic Techniques
excerpt: Blockchain analytics firm Chainalysis reported a data breach impacting customer names, email addresses, and organizational roles.
body_html:
Blockchain analytics company Chainalysis has revealed a data security incident. According to the firm, attackers utilized offensive agentic techniques to gain entry into internal tools and systems.

The unauthorized access resulted in the exposure of various customer details. The compromised information includes user names, email addresses, unique user identifiers, and associated organizational roles.

Investigations into the incident and the scope of the affected systems are ongoing as the organization addresses the security breach.
